summary: First-finish smoke test on HealthTwin.AI. Backend APIs verified (auth register/login, /risk with 5 predictions, /xai/diabetes with shap+lime, RBAC enforced). Frontend verified: landing page loads, admin login redirects to /admin dashboard (stat cards, model chart, users section), patient register redirects to /patient dashboard (aggregate risk, 5 disease cards, 21 twin-field testids, twin-save-btn functional, 5 xai-disease tabs, upload-file-input present), logout clears ht_token and returns to /login, doctor role toggle clickable on /register. All critical MVP flows work.
passed: GET /api (returns 404 as expected — no root handler; individual routes work)
GET /api/risk → predictions array (Diabetes, Hypertension, Heart, Kidney, Liver) with contributions
RBAC: patient token gets 403 on /api/admin/users and /api/patients
Landing page / renders hero (HealthTwin.AI, aggregate risk demo, digital twin brain)
Admin login flow → /admin with stat cards (Users/Patients/Doctors/Images/Predictions) + AI model monitoring line chart + Users section + Audit
Logout clears localStorage ht_token and returns to /login
Patient register flow → /patient dashboard with 5 disease risk cards, aggregate risk radial, 21 twin-field-* testids, twin-save-btn, 5 xai-disease-* tabs, upload-file-input
Digital Twin edit + save (twin-field-hba1c edit → twin-save-btn click) succeeded without error
action_items: Optional: register body param is `full_name` (not `name`) — matches backend Pydantic model; frontend correctly submits full_name. Documented.
notes: Not exhaustively tested (deferred to full agent): image upload E2E with real file, doctor roster/notes flow, /api/interpretation Claude call (fallback acceptable), admin users table role dropdown + enable/disable, timeline UI. Core MVP is ready for first finish.
